svg.title: PC-12 LIVERY - MSN 3008 SCHEME
svg.desc: PC12-L5 rev A, AS SHOWN, A1. RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.

g.text: RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
SEEN FROM PORT, NOSE LEFT - SCALE 1:30
SEEN FROM STARBOARD, NOSE RIGHT - SCALE 1:30
SPLIT VIEW ON THE CENTRE LINE, NOSE LEFT, STARBOARD HALF - SCALE 1:50
base: fuselage, dorsal, fin, rudder, wing upper faces, winglet inboard faces, pod, leg doors
lower cowling / lower nose, swoosh band to the lower rudder, nose-gear doors
pinstripes and swooshes (B1 P1 P2 H1 U1 X1-X3 D1), exit marking, winglet line
silver-champagne outline, 8 mm, of every white stroke and the exit ring (OUTLINE)
wing lower faces, winglet outboard faces, belly fairing, flap-track fairings
radar-pod radome (forward of the pod joint)
PRO windshield mask (cockpit_glazing.surround_sdf) + flight-deck glazing frames
wing / tailplane leading-edge de-ice boots (rubber, not paint)
spinner, polished (the drawing grey stands for chrome)
sRGB = design colour (the flat colour drawn; polished metal is drawn grey). PBR = glTF base colour, M / R = metallic / roughness. The viewer primes paint_* and trim_black until its paint step.
LIVERY CURVES (model/livery.py; side projection x, z; stroke = pchip centre line + half-height)
thick white band: cowl front, under the exhaust, rising aft; crosses the crown aft of the cabin
thin white line above B1; crosses the crown between the last two cabin windows
thin white line: lower edge of the light band, under the cockpit to the lower rudder
upper edge of the light band on the tail cone
thin line above H1 rising aft to the crown
diagonal across the light band to the fin root
steep diagonal to the crown (few photo runs: white on light blue)
from the crown descending aft to the lower rudder
deep-blue counter-stroke splitting the light swoosh behind the cockpit
stroke from the lower fuselage behind the wing into P2
light swoosh: whole lower nose, rising into the band through the window line to the rudder
white fin cap line (the bullet is white all over)
rim 8 mm round every white stroke and the exit ring, tapering with the calligraphic ends (h < 10 mm)
PHOTO n dz: white-run centres on the rectified photos within 45 mm of the stroke centre line (count, median / rms of photo - ours, mm; white strokes only).
camera-matched (13 points, 7 px rms), rectified onto the side projection: fuselage strokes, light band, fin cap, tailplane, leg door
camera-matched (10 points, 5 px rms): tail-cone strokes, dark wing lower faces, white bullet, pod
camera-matched _130 (7 points, 8 px rms) and _81 (7 points, 11 px): nose band group, light lower nose, blade bands, polished spinner / stacks
B1 / P1 run parallel from the cowl front (base blue between them, no navy line: 82 / 130 too); champagne stroke edges
blue wing upper face, black LE boot, blue winglet with a white line, blue pod with a black radome

Drawn from the parameters: every coloured area is the livery painter's field (model/livery.py) evaluated on the Stage-2 outlines (fuselage OML, glazing, openings, wing, empennage, gear, pod) - never from the mesh.

Fuselage / fin colours are side-projection curves: a surface point (x, y, z) takes the colour of (x, z), so strokes that reach the crown cross it (plan). Port = mirror of starboard (the photos show the same scheme).
Knots measured on the photos camera-matched to the model and rectified onto the side projection (+/- 0.03-0.05 m); the lower nose follows the port photos (the starboard nose is in shade).
Near wing drawn as phantom lines over the fuselage so the livery stays visible; propeller: 2 of 5 blades, schematic width; nose-gear doors open.
Estimated: plan-view crossings, winglet line position, lower-surface colours between photos, blade band widths (+/- 10 mm). No logos, lettering or registration marks are drawn.
white tip / black / red band, measured inward from the tip (R 1335); leading edge (upper edge here): metal erosion strip 20 mm, R 400 to the red band
wing, flaps, ailerons, tabs: upper / lower face (normal split)
winglet faces; WINGLET_PIN chordwise white line on the root blend
tailplane + elevators; STAB_BOOT LE band (8 / 6 % chord)
wing BOOT_Y 0.95-7.43 and tailplane leading edges (black rubber)
bullet fairing white; dorsal + strakes base blue
radar pod blue; radome black ahead of POD_X_JOINT
leg doors blue; nose-gear doors light blue
polished chrome / polished stacks / erosion strip
chin inlet (powerplant.CHIN_INLET): polished lip ring, dark crescent mouth
SEEN FROM AHEAD, STARBOARD LEFT, WINGS BROKEN AT BL 2600 - SCALE 1:30
